title: Who is Yahweh - How a Warrior-Storm God became the God of the Israelites and World Monotheism
summary: An ESOTERICA episode tracing Yahweh from a warrior-storm god near Mt Seir to the god of the Israelites in the Judean highlands. It examines how Yahwism absorbed and contended with Canaanite religion.
why: HN users recommend it as an impressively well-sourced, academic look at the origins of the Abrahamic religions.

quote.text: it was one of the few videos I’ve seen recently that really impressed me
